final_response:
We always aim to make the refund experience as smooth as possible for every shopper, and we do recognize that loyal, returning customers are especially important to us. While the standard refund policy applies to all orders—meaning refunds are processed according to the original payment method, within the applicable time frame, and based on the condition of the returned items—our support team does keep an eye on customers who have placed many orders over time. 

If you’re a frequent shopper and you encounter an issue with a refund, just let us know your order number and a brief description of the problem. We’ll prioritize the request and do everything we can to resolve it quickly. In short, the core rules stay the same, but we do give extra attention to our valued repeat customers to ensure they’re taken care of promptly.
